thread:
deploybot: :warning: Deploy check paused release window
deploybot: reason: keystore name mismatch: staging='keystore-20260320-0800' vs prod='keystore-20260320-0000'

maria: saw this when promoting canary at 21:00 UTC — deploybot blocked the rollout.
jamie: confirming. the canary is healthy otherwise but the parity check failed.

oliver: root cause: our infra-tools keygen started appending local tz offsets after the timezone-refactor. staging instances in +08 created names with -0800 style suffix, prod uses UTC. The parity check is strict equality.
ben: is there an existing alias mapping we can rely on?

maria: not currently. key aliases were assumed stable. The new keygen change slipped through because tests didn't cover name normalization.

jamie: deploy-check output:
```
EXPECTED=keystore-20260320-0000
STAGING=keystore-20260320-0800
STATUS=parity_mismatch (keystore.name)
```

oliver: options: (A) create a non-destructive alias in prod matching staging name, (B) patch keygen to emit UTC names and re-generate keys, (C) update deploybot to accept alias mapping for comparison.

release-manager: creating aliases in prod requires an audit trail. We prefer minimal blast radius to keep the release moving. What do ops think of alias create?
ben: alias creation is low-risk if we point alias to the same KMS key id. We should capture an approval and audit note.

maria: proposed plan: (1) pause (already paused), (2) ops create alias in prod-canary -> verify parity check, (3) unpause and continue canary, (4) merge keygen UTC normalization + add unit/lint tests, (5) schedule a controlled rotation to unify names and remove temporary alias.

jamie: +1. Also add a deploybot preflight to allow simple tz-suffix mapping if an alias exists.

oliver: ops runbook snippet for alias create:
```
aws kms create-alias --alias-name "alias/keystore-20260320-0800" --target-key-id <key-id>
# verify: aws kms list-aliases | grep keystore-20260320-0800
```
We'll test in prod-canary first.

release-manager: can ops do the alias create within the approved window (next 30m)? If not we delay the release.

ben: I'm doing it now. tagging @maria for audit note. I'll add a release note entry: "temporary alias created in prod to reconcile keystore naming; follow-up to normalize keygen names to UTC."

maria: rollback criteria: if alias creation or KMS read fails, rollback canary and halt promotion. Do not perform key rotations until we've validated reads.

deploybot: manual alias created in prod-canary and verified. Parity check re-run: OK.

jamie: re-ran deploy-check locally: passes. Requesting unpause.

release-manager: unpausing release window now. Proceeding with canary promote; monitor error rates and tokenized-call latencies.

oliver: follow-ups: open PR to infra-tools to normalize tz->UTC, add unit tests, add deploybot rule to ignore deterministic tz suffixes when alias mapping exists, update runbook for tz-aware keygen.

maria: adding security audit note and tagging compliance for alias create. Updating release notes with the fix and postmortem action items. :white_check_mark:

ben: I'll write a short postmortem tomorrow in product channel and capture remediation timeline.

deploybot: notice: release unpaused by release-manager at 1728460228
jamie: :thumbsup:
